title: Steam Navigator combat ability content file (Content Schema 2.0)
description: Combat ability / AI behavior parameters (D1). Abilities are data, not scripts: they pick one S-N Battle Simulator FSM action and tune the tactic thresholds the runtime AI consumes. IDs use core:combat_ability/*.

action.description: Primary FSM action (SNBattleSim FSM_ACTIONS): recon / cruise / approach / flank / evade / maneuver / withdraw / flee / engage / focus.

target_priority.description: Which enemy the AI prefers (SNBattleSim tactic.targetPriority).

preferred_range.description: Preferred engagement range as a 0–1 fraction of weapon range (tactic.preferredRange).

approach_threshold.description: Approach when the target is farther than this multiple of preferred range (tactic.approachThreshold).

withdraw_threshold.description: Withdraw when the target is closer than this multiple (tactic.withdrawThreshold).

retreat_hull.description: Hull ratio below which the ability retreats (tactic.retreatHull).

cargo_behavior.description: How a convoy escort reacts when its cargo is threatened.
